citation.locator: Corrected release, first paragraph, second sentence
citation.verbatim: The Board of Directors of Zoetis Inc. (NYSE:ZTS) declared a second quarter dividend payable to holders of the company's common stock of $0.072 per share. The dividend is to be paid on June 2, 2014 to holders of record on April 28, 2014.

Confirm the 25,000-share record-date position. Hold the DRIP reinvestment-price determination pending the missing reinvestment-price document.
